task_description: Check out a release by its version number such as 2.4.1.
Resize a video to a given width in pixels with ffmpeg.
Send a desktop notification with a message.
Show the network details of an interface name such as eth0.
Look up DNS records for a domain name.
Switch the power profile to one of: performance, balanced, saver.
Create a new system user with a given name.
Show the last lines of a log file chosen by the caller.
Return the logged-in sessions of a given user name.
